decision.title: Anna hummingbird — existing flight baseline appearance
decision.summary: Existing four-pose flutter is PROVISIONALLY USEFUL as a bounded airborne source subset. Takeoff and landing joins remain HELD. Drive/brake poses are useful studies, while the assembled cross-pack sequence remains diagnostic rather than accepted continuous flight. Thirteen reused identities, zero new drawings/calls.

clips.reason: Genuine wing/body pose changes are readable at normal64world; recognizable individual and broadly coherent airborne body. Cadence is visibly stepped and mid-recovery resembles the raised-wing pose. This does not establish seamless hover or measured biological wingbeat.

Grounded/folded reference switches abruptly into an already wing-raised release. Weighted grounded wing-engaged preparation and a continuous push/release handoff are absent; authored root ascent cannot create those missing drawings.

Approach/reach keys are real source art, but transition to folded arrival snaps visibly. Head/bill/body placement and instant wing fold do not demonstrate a contact-safe settle. Proposed near toe coincidence is not physical landing proof.

Forward-pitch and upright brake alternatives read as distinct genuine poses. Cross-pack pitch/head/wing changes remain abrupt in this common-origin diagnostic; no smooth wing/body handoff or continuous dart is established.

decision.normalSizeFinding: All four one-shots were inspected live on light/dark with diagnostic markers switched off. Source96x96 images draw at64x64world, density1.5, inside180x170 backing canvases (182x172CSS including border). Source normal64 light/dark sheet also inspected. At30Hz, hover24ticks ends23, takeoff42ends41, landing42ends41 and drive/brake36ends35; all stop at their real last sample. Memory inspection windows were hover1→3, takeoff15→17, landing21→23 and drive/brake18→20. No page errors or saved capture files.
decision.qualifications: The floor is illustrative and support labels are authored/unbound proposals. Contacts[]/supportWorldnull does not independently prove flight or support. Individual toe/sole/pressure, root-contact geometry, body/wing clock joins and full takeoff/landing remain unapproved. Root trajectories are authored separately from actual drawings, with no generated-animation credit for translations. No generated intermediary, cycle-completion or new source coverage is claimed. Full technical/current Mac/runtime/live admission is NOT_TESTED. Review destination follows parent-authorized external reviews/appearance rather than adding files to the frozen baseline root.
